summary: Tested Courier Document Management features for AgrosJet admin panel. All 4 features verified: 1) Courier completion message when all docs uploaded (code verified), 2) Admin can view signed contract PDF, 3) Admin can download merged PDF, 4) Admin has Reset buttons for Contract/Fesih/Documents. Backend: 13/16 tests passed (3 skipped due to rate limiting). Frontend: All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: GET /api/contracts/status/{courier_id} correctly returns accepted, fesih_accepted, accepted_at, fesih_accepted_at, and contract r2_key
Backend: POST /api/contracts/reset-contract/{courier_id} resets contract_accepted, fesih_accepted and deletes contract records
Backend: POST /api/contracts/reset-documents/{courier_id} deletes all documents except company_contract
Backend: GET /api/documents/courier/{courier_id}/download-merged-pdf returns valid merged PDF (8.9MB for test courier)
Backend: GET /api/documents/courier/{courier_id}/status returns all_complete=true when 7/7 documents uploaded
Frontend: CourierDocumentsSection.jsx has all required data-testids: reset-contract-btn, reset-fesih-btn, reset-documents-btn, download-merged-pdf, download-all-documents, view-contract-pdf-admin
Frontend: Admin Evraklar tab shows SÖZLEŞME DURUMU section with contract/fesih status and Sıfırla buttons
Frontend: Admin Evraklar tab shows Tek PDF and ZIP download buttons
Frontend: CourierEvraklarPage.jsx shows 'Evrak Süreciniz Tamamlandı' success message when status.all_complete=true (lines 481-512)
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing test couriers
